description: None of the three Capella Search-index-creation pages (create-search-indexes, create-search-index-ui, create-search-index-alias) document any role/privilege/credential-type requirement for creating a Search index or alias. This is inconsistent in two directions at once: server/'s equivalent pages DO name a 'Search Admin' privilege, and Capella's own vector-index pages (a close sibling feature) DO use requiresCapellaRole. Search stands out as the one area with no access-control documentation at all on Capella.
